name: newsletter
description: An email list: opt-in boxes at sign-up and in Settings, one-click unsubscribe, and an admin page to write and send updates.

envExample.name: NEWSLETTER_SECRET
envExample.comment:
Email list. A private random value that makes the unsubscribe links. Shipyard fills this in.
Keep it: links already sent stop working if it changes.

envExample.name: NEWSLETTER_CONSENT_NOT_BEFORE
envExample.comment: Email list. Optional. Shipyard sets this when sign-ups start needing a confirmed email: ticks collected before that time are ignored until people tick again.

patches.note: Show the email updates box in Settings: add <NewsletterSettings /> (from @/components/newsletter/NewsletterSettings) inside the page.

Add the optional updates box to the sign-up form: show <SignupNewsletterOptIn email={email} /> (from @/components/newsletter/SignupNewsletterOptIn) when the form is in sign-up mode. People can still switch updates on later in Settings.
Make the sign-up box work: add <NewsletterIntentApplier /> (from @/components/newsletter/NewsletterIntentApplier) once in src/app/layout.tsx, next to the other small helpers.
Add the newsletter checks to the Health page: spread newsletterHealthChecks (from @/lib/newsletter/health) into the list of checks.
List this table of personal data for account deletion in a shared Supabase project: add { table: "newsletter_subscribers", column: "user_id" } to ACCOUNT_DATA_TABLES in src/lib/account/pre-delete.ts.

next: Sign in as the owner and open Settings, then Send an update (or go to /admin/newsletter). Send yourself a test first.
Updates only open once sign-ups need a confirmed email address (so nobody can sign up someone else's address): finish the email setup, then switch on confirmed sign-ups.
To email everyone you need a verified sending domain: run the email setup (launch-email.mjs) in Shipyard.
Update your privacy policy so it mentions email updates: run legal-generate.mjs again.
